primaryChecks.text: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for the LORD’s house, of bright bronze.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 「ヨルダンの平野」と地名が明記される。川の流路と平野の範囲は同一視せず、鋳造位置の具体的地点は本文から決めない。
